description: This file contains functions for generating a gross and net profit report in an accounting system, including data processing, revenue calculation, and profit computation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate columns and data for the gross and net profit report based on filters.

methods.name: get_revenue
methods.description: Calculates revenue data, filtering and adjusting account entries for gross or net revenue.

methods.name: remove_parent_with_no_child
methods.description: Removes parent account entries that have no child accounts.

methods.name: adjust_account
methods.description: Adjusts account data to reflect totals for each account over the period list.

methods.name: set_total
methods.description: Recursively sets total values for accounts and their parent accounts.

methods.name: get_profit
methods.description: Calculates gross profit for each period based on income and expense data.

methods.name: get_net_profit
methods.description: Calculates net profit for each period considering gross and non-gross income and expenses.
